en.title: Star Wars Battlefront 3 Rumors Ignite With DICE and Respawn in Focus
en.summary: Whispers of a new Star Wars Battlefront game are growing louder, with Lucasfilm reportedly seeking a development partner. Could DICE and Respawn be joining forces for the iconic shooter sequel?
en.body:
The Force is strong with the rumor mill once again, as chatter surrounding a potential **Star Wars Battlefront 3** has reached a fever pitch. Recent reports, stemming from insights shared by sources like Giant Bomb's Jeff Grubb and the revived EGM Quarterman column, suggest that Lucasfilm has significant ambitions for the beloved shooter franchise and is actively searching for a studio to bring it to life.

While no official confirmation has been made, the names being floated are enough to get any Star Wars fan's pulse racing. Initially, **DICE**, the Swedish studio responsible for the **Battlefield** series and the previous **Battlefront** entries, was seen as the most logical contender. However, the rumor gained a surprising twist with the mention of **Bungie**, the creators of **Halo** and **Destiny**. This potential pairing raised eyebrows, given Bungie's current focus on their extraction shooter **Marathon** and their ongoing Destiny commitments, making their involvement seem unlikely for a project of Battlefront 3's scale at this moment. Adding further intrigue, a tweet from Joe Brammer, head of **Wardogs** developer Bulkhead, pointed towards **Respawn Entertainment**, the studio behind **Titanfall**, **Apex Legends**, and the **Star Wars Jedi** series, working alongside DICE on the project. This collaboration, if true, could represent a fascinating fusion of development strengths.

## The Fan Reaction to a New Battlefront

The mere possibility of a new **Star Wars Battlefront** game has ignited a passionate response from the community. For many, the series represents a pinnacle of Star Wars gaming, offering epic large-scale battles that truly capture the spirit of the films. The original **Battlefront** and **Battlefront II** (2005) are still cherished classics, and while the DICE-developed rebooted series had its ups and downs, the potential for a third installment, especially with whispers of experienced studios like DICE and Respawn involved, is incredibly exciting. Fans are eager to see how modern technology and development expertise could be applied to create an even more immersive and expansive galactic conflict, potentially incorporating elements from the sequel trilogy and recent Disney+ series.

## What's Next for Battlefront 3?

At this stage, all indications point to **Star Wars Battlefront 3** being in the very early stages of discussion and potential planning. Lucasfilm is reportedly still in the process of securing a development partner, meaning production has likely not yet begun. Fans should keep a close eye on official announcements from **Lucasfilm Games** and the implicated studios for any concrete news regarding development or a potential release window, though details have not yet been announced.

content_raw: Talk of Star Wars Battlefront 3 has ramped up this week, with a number of studios reportedly in with a chance of developing the shooter sequel. The rumor kicked off when Giant Bomb’s Jeff Grubb read out a snippet from Electronic Gaming Monthly’s revived Quarterman column, which claimed Disney has “big plans” for the Star Wars Battlefront series. According to EGM, Lucasfilm is looking for a development partner for Battlefront 3, and two studios are “circling” the project: DICE, developer of Battlefield and Battlefront, and Bungie, developer of Halo, Destiny, and Marathon. The potential for a Battlefront 3 is hugely exciting for fans of the series, of course, and if it does end up green lit, DICE would be the obvious course to develop it, although how the game would fit with the ongoing work on the Battlefield series remains to be seen. Bungie, though, would be a huge surprise as developer of Battlefront 3. The Sony-owned studio is working to turn around struggling extraction shooter Marathon, and only last month Bungie said more Destiny is coming , months after ending support for Destiny 2. It feels unlikely that Bungie would have the scope to make a fully fleshed out Battlefront 3, at least not any time soon. Would parent company Sony even be receptive to such an idea? Would Bungie? Plot twist! Joe Brammer, boss of Wardogs developer Bulkhead, just… tweeted it out . But rather than Bungie, it’s Titanfall, Apex Legends, and Star Wars Jedi developer Respawn that’s working with DICE on Battlefront 3, according to Brammer. "DICE and from what I’ve heard Respawn are working on Battlefront 3," he said on X / Twitter. "Not sure what that means for Battlefield." What’s actually going on here? Well, it doesn’t sound like Battlefront 3 is in production yet, if Lucasfilm is on the hunt for development partners. But it’s entirely plausible that DICE and Respawn have done pre-production work, fleshing out what the game will be and how it will work, while looking for studios to help build it. And before we get our hopes up, it’s worth remembering that Battlefront fans have been here before. TimeSplitters developer Free Radical Design has a Battlefront 3 game that was pretty much done before it fell by the wayside around 2008. Assets and even builds of the game have leaked online ever since. EA eventually had DICE pick up the mantle and reboot the series with the hugely popular Star Wars Battlefront in 2015. But its sequel, 2017’s Battlefront 2, suffered a disastrous launch fueled by a backlash to loot boxes . DICE spent years righting the ship, to the point now where Battlefront 2 is held in pretty high regard . If DICE is working on Battlefront 3 in some capacity, it’ll do so without much of the original development team, which scattered to various studios in Sweden and abroad in the wake of Battlefront 2’s release.
